title: Finding Your Groove
use_cases: Use when evaluating the narrative flow of a manuscript
Implement when struggling with the pacing of descriptive passages
Configure when training writers to identify sentence rhythm
Use when scheduling one-on-one coaching sessions for voice development
content:
Like developing musical talent, finding your prose rhythm takes practice. As one client noted after we worked through his description: “You can feel it but it’s not like math… it’s not a pure science.”

That’s exactly right. It’s more like developing an ear for music. With time and attention, you begin to hear when a sentence hits the right beat and when it’s off tempo.

The next time you’re writing description, don’t worry about how many details to include. Instead, listen for the rhythm of your words. Ask yourself: Does this flow? Does each sentence deliver one clear beat? Am I giving my reader time to process each image before moving to the next?

When you find that rhythm—that perfect groove where each sentence flows naturally into the next—your readers won’t be counting the details. They’ll be too busy enjoying the music of your words.
